name: NGC 472 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 472, a compact elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc0472-hubble
story: A small, densely packed elliptical galaxy that resembles the compact galaxies of the early universe more than its modern neighbors. Its outline twists from the center outward, a hint that its true shape is not simply round or flattened.

claims.text: NGC 472 is a compact elliptical galaxy imaged by Hubble program GO-13050
Nearby compact elliptical galaxies are dense, are outliers today, and resemble the compact, massive, quiescent galaxies of the early universe (local analogues)
Hubble program 13050 'The Most Massive Black Holes in Small Galaxies' imaged NGC0472 to hunt for overmassive black holes in compact early-type galaxies
NGC 472 shows strong isophotal twists, a significant change of position angle from inner to outer regions, suggesting a triaxial shape
